apps.description: PostgreSQL hosting service. Private by default; review ingress, runtime credentials and backup policy before use.

files.pg_hba.conf:
local all all trust
host all all 0.0.0.0/0 scram-sha-256
host all all ::/0 scram-sha-256

hooks.wrapper:
if [ "${2-}" = "--version" ]; then exec "$1" --version; fi
bin="${1%/*}"
if [ ! -f /state/home/data/PG_VERSION ]; then
  "$bin/initdb" -D /state/home/data --auth-host=scram-sha-256 --auth-local=trust --username=silo --pwfile=/run/credentials/password || exit $?
fi
exec "$bin/postgres" -D /state/home/data -h "*" -k /tmp -c hba_file=/app/pg_hba.conf
